Army Customisation allows you to further individualise your force. Archetypes change how you build your army by moving around units in the Army Organisation Plan (AOP) or letting you take more of a unit than you would normally be allowed to. Legacies give access to armories and disciplines of legendary factions. Traits enhance your units with special abilities that they normally would not be able to have.

You may select up to the following:
0-1 Archetype, 0-1 Legacy, 0-2 Traits

If a Trait is taken, all models / units in the army must be upgraded with it, unless stated otherwise.

- Can only select Crypteks as HQ units.
- Up to two Crypteks may be taken for every HQ slot.
- <Canoptek> units gain the "Objective secured!" ability.

- The army has access to the following units only, regardless of other traits:
- Ancient Destroyer Lords, Crypteks with Skorpekh body, Lords with Destroyer bodies, Skorpekh Lords
- Flayed Ones
- Canoptek Reanimators, Canoptek Spyders, C'tan Shards (any), Plasmacytes, Skorpekh Destroyers
- Canoptek Scarabs, Canoptek Wraiths, Ophydian Destroyers
- Canoptek Doomstalkers, Lokhust Destroyers
- Skorpekh Destroyers can be taken as Troops.

- A Lord or Overlord must be taken as an HQ selection.
- Lychguard and Triarch Praetorians can be taken as Troops.
- No other Troop units may be selected.

- One C'tan shard (any kind) counts as an HQ selection.
- The model gains +1 Strength, +1 Toughness, +1 Initiative, +1 Attacks and a 2+ armor save.
- The range for each C'tan power is increased by 6" and it knows the "Time's Arrow" power. 
- It costs an additional +85 points.
- Pariahs can be taken as Troops.
The army has access to equipment from the Nephrekh dynasty in the Dynasty Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Szarekhan dynasty in the Dynasty Armory.

The army has access to equipment from the Nihilakh dynasty in the Dynasty Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Mephrit dynasty in the Dynasty Armory.
The army has access to equipment from the Sautekh dynasty in the Dynasty Armory.
If the unit uses a Charge order or gets charged by an enemy unit, it gains +1 to melee hit rolls until the end of the current battle round.
The unit prevents 1 RPoint from being lost for itself and gains 1 temporary RPoint each Reinforcement phase, if it is within 6" of an objective marker. Only for <Necron> units.
If the unit uses Stand & Shoot, it gains a +1 bonus to armor saves until its next activation. Can't be combined with "Merciless hunters".
Vehicle units can fire all weapons, if they move up to 12". Only for vehicles.
The unit's "Rapid Fire" weapons gain +1 Strength when being resolved against targets that are within half weapon range.
The unit can re-roll one hit roll per activation.
The unit can fire "Rapid Fire" weapons twice at full range with a "Stand & Shoot" order. Can't be combined with "Immovable phalanx".
Enemy units within 3" of the unit suffer a -1 penalty to their Toughness.
The unit gains the "Vanguard" ability . Can't be combined with "Translocation beams".
The unit's weapons increase their range by 3".
The unit can re-roll one armor penetration or wound roll per activation.
The unit can re-roll failed Leadership tests.
The unit automatically advances 6" instead of rolling for it, ignoring terrain. Can't be combined with "Relentless expansionism".
The army must select a second Legacy. Each model may only select items from one Legacy armory.
The unit's ranged attacks gain a -1 AP bonus when being resolved against targets that are within half weapon range.
The unit can re-roll one (additional) hit and one (additional) wound roll per activation. Only for HQ units.
The point costs for traits have to be paid per unit. If point costs are marked with *, then they must be paid for every Wound or Hull point in the unit.
